title: Manufacturing, storing, selling, distributing or importing adulterated products
description: Manufacturing, storing, selling, distributing or importing products containing adulterants

content.offence: Manufactures for sale or stores or sells or distributes or imports any product containing an adulterant
content.punishment: Imprisonment for a term which may extend to six months and with fine which may extend to one lakh rupees

aliases: penalty for adulterated products resulting in death
